headline: MERZ 🏛️ Calls Election 🗳️ a TOTAL 💥 DISASTER 🚨 But VOWS 🗣️ To STAY 🍆 ON
text:
German Chancellor 🍺 Friedrich Merz just got his centre-right CDU 🐘 party absolutely COOKED 🍳 in two brutal 🩸 state elections 🗳️ with exit polls 📊 showing them scraping 🪚 through or dipping ⬇️ below the 5% 📉 threshold in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern 🌲 after he called it straight up a DISASTER 🔥 for his crew 👥!! The far-right AfD 🐺 was on track to snatch 🥇 the most votes 🗳️ there but other parties 🚫 won't touch 🤝 them so no governing 👑 for the extremists yet while in Berlin 🏙️ the ruling CDU got absolutely SMOKED 🔥 by Die Linke 🌹 who never topped polls 📈 before but now sit at nearly 26% with Merz's boys barely hitting 19% and AfD climbing to 16% 📈!!

Merz who has only been chancellor 👔 for 16 months 🗓️ is under MOUNTING ⛰️ pressure with poor approval ratings 📉 and wild rumours 🗣️ he could get replaced mid-term in a so-called chancellor swap 🔄 but the man is standing FIRM 🪨 vowing to stay on despite this latest L 😩 after the CDU vote got halved two weeks ago in Saxony-Anhalt 🏞️ where AfD scored a major victory 🏆!! Echoing his previous comments he told reporters 📰 at the party's Berlin headquarters 🏢 that he would forge ahead 🚀 with the coalition government's plans to ram through a massive package 📦 of economic 💰 tax 💸 and welfare reforms because quote The reforms have to come he insisted I am taking on this responsibility because I want to move our country forward 🏃‍♂️!!

What needs to be done now requires backbone 🦴 steadfastness 💪 and patience ⌛ Merz said I will demonstrate this as CDU party chairman 🪑 and above all as chancellor of our country he added that these reforms are literally the antidote 💉 to the authoritarian poison ☣️ that with the fascination of authoritarianism is penetrating ever deeper into our society 🌍!! The AfD's national co-leader Alice Weidel dropped her own victory speech 🏆 saying We are the strongest force and have reached the mainstream of the population while some branches of the populist AfD are classed as right-wing extremist by domestic intelligence 🕵️ a label they strongly reject 🚫 but their anti-immigration German-first and Russian-friendly agenda has found fertile ground 🪴 in the country's former communist east 🏭!!

There was a super muted 😶 response at the CDU's election night gathering 🥳 in Berlin with no cheers or celebration 🎉 as the projected results 📊 flashed up on the screen and the party that knows it's in deep trouble 🪦 saw its leader Merz immediately go on the offensive 🗡️ declaring he is going NOWHERE 🚫!! This dude has long coveted the top job 👑 in German politics and likely won't give it up easily so even though public broadcasters ZDF 📺 and ARD put AfD slightly ahead at 38% in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern with CDU posting its worst result in any state since World War Two 🪖 and SPD at 35% he is digging in his heels 🦶!!

Prior to Sunday's polls closing at 18:00 local time ⏰ there had been intense speculation 🔍 across Germany that Merz could be replaced unless his party's political fortunes improved but earlier this week the leaders of eight German states threw their backing behind him and on Sunday Burkard Dregger from the CDU in Berlin told the BBC it was right that Merz should stay on because he has a lot of work to do and we don't have time to waste forming a new government at the federal level 🏛️!! He described the electorate as impatient adding it was not realistic to expect that every issue has been solved within one year and that he has got four years and we have to give him the four years while his backers argue many problems are inherited yet Merz himself remains deeply unpopular with his tack to the right on immigration failing to dent AfD support and also alienating the left side 🥷!!
